_about: Corrections applied by scripts/build-career-index.py ON TOP of the owner's workbook (industry accuracy review 2026-09-04). The workbook stays the source; these keep the app honest until the workbook is revised. Titles are matched exactly.
_topicGs_about: Family curriculum links, by family name → explicit v3 global_sequence topics (owner 2026-09-04). The workbook's 'Key app topics' for the Professional Practice families named subjects/columns that don't resolve to v3 topics, so those families fell back to generic links and Music Curation got none. These are ccode's recommended picks from the live v3 curriculum; every gs is validated against active v3 at build. Adjust freely.
_pe_rule: Every title ending in 'Engineer' or 'Consultant' inside the Architectural Acoustics family: offering engineering services to the public commonly needs a PE licence.

_craft_rule: In these craft families a degree is neither common nor expected for the working roles; the workbook's 'Bachelor's degree common' is a spreadsheet default from title class. Rows whose preparation is that default are re-tabled: technician/operator/assistant/stagehand rows to hands-on training, everything else to the 'varies' pathway.
_tier_rule: A row the workbook itself calls 'Closely related / supporting' or 'Audio-dependent allied work' cannot also be 'Direct audio occupation' (audio-core). Such rows are shown as audio-specialized.
